study type: Data note / Methodology description for a Cohort study (ALSPAC)
exposure: Maternal signs and symptoms during pregnancy, labour, delivery, and the first two weeks of puerperium
Maternal procedures and treatments during pregnancy, labour, delivery, and the first two weeks of puerperium
outcome: Long-term health and development of mother
Long-term health and development of child
cohort: The participants are 13,705 pregnancies within the Avon Longitudinal Study of Parents and Children (ALSPAC) cohort, with 8369 having detailed obstetric records and a further 5336 having specific prenatal details.
finding: This data note describes the successful, albeit time-consuming and expensive, abstraction of detailed clinical obstetric data concerning mothers during pregnancy, labour, delivery, and the first two weeks of the puerperium for a significant portion of the ALSPAC cohort.
followup_time: First two weeks of the puerperium (for data collection described in this note); ALSPAC is a long-term longitudinal study.
